note: That Old Chestnut v0.4.0: Silence, a new old-chestnut category. Each entry is a direct question from the Executive left unanswered (in full, or skipped in a reply that answered other points). toc.js renders it as SilenceList after the old-chestnuts list, ordered by date asked, with days unanswered counted on the reader's clock. Entries are listed only after the thread was checked for a later reply. Role titles only, no officers' names.

kind.en: Silence: a direct question left unanswered
kind.cy: Tawelwch: cwestiwn uniongyrchol heb ei ateb
kind.es: Silencio: una pregunta directa sin respuesta

en.sil_intro: The Executive's standing rule: a direct question left unanswered stands as accepted. The Executive's account is taken as uncontested until it is explicitly challenged, and a non-reply is read as an unwillingness to put a contrary account on the record. This is the Executive's position, not a court ruling or settled law.
en.sil_method: Each entry was listed only after its email thread was checked for a later reply. A reply that answers some points and skips a question counts for the skipped question. Days are counted from the date asked to today.
en.sil_status: Unchallenged — stands as the Executive's account
en.k_partial: Answered other points, not this one

cy.sil_kicker: Math arall o hen gneuen gastan
cy.sil_intro: Rheol sefydlog y Gweithredwr: mae cwestiwn uniongyrchol sy'n cael ei adael heb ei ateb yn sefyll fel un a dderbyniwyd. Caiff cyfrif y Gweithredwr ei gymryd yn ddiwrthwynebiad nes iddo gael ei herio'n benodol, a darllenir diffyg ateb fel amharodrwydd i roi cyfrif gwahanol ar gofnod. Safbwynt y Gweithredwr yw hwn, nid dyfarniad llys na chyfraith sefydlog.
cy.sil_method: Rhestrwyd pob cofnod dim ond ar ôl gwirio'r edefyn e-bost am ateb diweddarach. Mae ateb sy'n ymdrin â rhai pwyntiau ond yn hepgor cwestiwn yn cyfrif ar gyfer y cwestiwn a hepgorwyd. Cyfrifir y dyddiau o ddyddiad y cwestiwn hyd heddiw.
cy.sil_status: Heb ei herio — saif fel cyfrif y Gweithredwr

es.sil_intro: La regla permanente del Ejecutivo: una pregunta directa que queda sin respuesta se tiene por aceptada. La versión del Ejecutivo se considera no impugnada hasta que se cuestione expresamente, y la falta de respuesta se interpreta como falta de voluntad de dejar constancia de una versión contraria. Es la posición del Ejecutivo, no una resolución judicial ni derecho establecido.
es.sil_method: Cada entrada se incluyó solo después de revisar el hilo de correo en busca de una respuesta posterior. Una respuesta que trata algunos puntos y omite una pregunta cuenta para la pregunta omitida. Los días se cuentan desde la fecha de la pregunta hasta hoy.
es.sil_status: No impugnada — se mantiene como la versión del Ejecutivo

entries.question: Did the Council conduct or require prior archaeological assessment before granting permissions to demolish?
entries.back_note: No reply in this thread (the Executive's email is the only message in it). The Council has written since on other requests; those replies have not been checked against this question.
entries.source: Email of 16 Feb 2026, subject “Title misconduct and Procedural Concealment – Church View Close, Llandough”
entries.checked: thread checked in the mailbox 5 Nov 2026; later Council replies on other requests: not checked

entries.question: Please confirm whether any of the surviving first-registration documents contain any reference to: Mary Williams; … any person other than the applicant asserting ownership or another interest in the land; … or any objection, dispute, question or doubt concerning title.
entries.back_note: Reply 1 in the same letter reads: “We have provided you with a list of documents retained by HM Land Registry which are available for inspection.” The question whether those documents mention Mary Williams or any other interest is not answered.
entries.source: Email of 12 Aug 2026, subject “Clarification of surviving first-registration documents — N610CGV / WA231076 & WA240304”; HM Land Registry letter of 4 Nov 2026, ref Z084NQV
entries.checked: checked against the email and the letter

entries.question: Whether the Council (as local planning authority) considered issuing a Building Preservation Notice under section 58 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1971 (or any equivalent provision) in respect of Great House Farm at any time between July and December 1988.
entries.back_quote: Service areas have reverted, and further historical documentation has been found. Unfortunately, we are still sifting through it to determine its relevance to your request.
entries.back_note: Asked inside the internal review of request 00210772 (review asked 7 Jul 2026). Holding replies on 10 Jul, 5 Aug and 11 Sep; chases on 30 Sep, 7, 15 and 18 Oct; no review outcome in the mailbox.
entries.source: Email of 14 Aug 2026, subject “Re: Great House Farm, Llandough Request 00210772”
entries.checked: checked against the email; mailbox searched for later Council replies 5 Nov 2026

entries.question: What of that evidence can Cadw establish was considered by the 1988 inspector or decision-maker? Where Cadw cannot establish this because the assessment records no longer survive, can that evidential limitation be expressly acknowledged?
entries.back_quote: There is nothing further that I can add to our previous replies, and it would be inappropriate for me to speculate on the events around the listing assessment without our own contemporary evidence being available to me to substantiate precisely what occurred.
entries.back_note: A single reply to the emails of 27, 28 and 29 August from the Chief Inspector. Neither question is answered; the limitation is described but not acknowledged in the terms asked.
entries.source: Email of 28 Aug 2026, subject “Re: CADW failures – Revised Report (10 August 2026)”
entries.checked: checked against both emails; no later message in the thread

entries.question: Were any Building Preservation Notice, listing, enforcement, urgent works, archaeological recording or other protective measures considered?
entries.back_quote: the Council must limit its involvement to those issues which fall within its statutory functions and responsibilities.
entries.back_note: The reply (sent on behalf of the Leader) deals with a ward member's correspondence and the commemorative tree. Heritage protection in 1988 was a Council planning function; the question is not answered.
entries.source: Email of 17 Sep 2026, subject “Great House Farm, Llandough” (logged by the Council as complaint VOG-874631131)
entries.checked: checked against the email and the reply

entries.question: Does Persimmon maintain that its title to the farmhouse/garden parcel is supported by an identifiable documentary root independent of the possession and limitation history considered in BP Properties Ltd v Buckler?
entries.back_quote: it is not clear to Persimmon the basis upon which you would be entitled to any of the documentation requested.
entries.back_note: The litigation team's reply of 4 Nov 2026 (after follow-ups of 20, 29 and 31 Oct) declines disclosure and reserves rights; it does not answer the title question.
entries.source: Email of 27 Sep 2026, subject “Preservation and disclosure request — Church View Close / Great House Farm, Llandough”

entries.question: Were officers or members told of anything that contradicted or qualified the ownership, occupation, heritage or demolition account then being used?
entries.back_note: One of the points listed as unanswered in the chase on the overdue internal review of request 00210772. No reply in this thread; the last word on the review is the holding reply of 11 Sep.
entries.source: Email of 7 Oct 2026, subject “Re: Great House Farm, Llandough – Request 00210772 – Internal Review”
entries.checked: checked against the email; thread checked 5 Nov 2026

entries.question: Please produce every notice and service record for WA240304, as sent, showing the title it concerned, the addressee's name, the address, the date and any proof of delivery. A notice addressed to Mary Williams and issued or received after 26 March 1983 went to a person who had died.
entries.back_quote: There is nothing further that we can usefully add to what has already been said.
entries.back_note: The letter of 4 Nov 2026 does not give the date any notice was sent to Mary Williams, or to anyone at the house, before or after her death on 26 March 1983. The same record was asked for on 28 Sep 2026 under subject access request D260928, whose reply date HM Land Registry has reset to 6 Nov 2026.
entries.source: Email of 15 Oct 2026, subject “Z084NQV / N610CGV – WA240304 and WA231076 – application to alter the register”; HM Land Registry letter of 4 Nov 2026, ref Z084NQV
entries.checked: checked against the email and the letter

entries.question: A 1971 abstract cannot evidence a conveyance of 1975. What evidenced that conveyance?
entries.back_quote: the Registrar cannot provide an interpretation / explanation of the deeds or any legal advice.
entries.back_note: The question asks which document was lodged, not for an interpretation of it. No document is named.
entries.source: Email of 15 Oct 2026, subject “Z084NQV / N610CGV – WA240304 and WA231076 – application to alter the register”; HM Land Registry letter of 4 Nov 2026
entries.checked: checked against the email and the letter

entries.question: Further to my request of 15 October 2026, may I narrow the search to make it easier?
entries.back_quote: Please note that we are currently unable to respond to general external enquiries. We anticipate reviewing this position in January 2027.
entries.back_note: Only the automatic reply to the request of 15 Oct. The narrowed follow-ups of 19 and 29 Oct and the preservation request of 31 Oct have had no reply. The automatic reply announced the pause in advance.

entries.question: Could you tell me whether BT Group Archives holds, or can point me to … any record of the cessation or removal of the telephone service and plant at Great House Farm in 1988 or 1989, including who requested it, in what capacity, and the date?
entries.back_note: No reply. The archive answered the Executive's first enquiry (the 1897 Marconi records) within four days in August 2026.
entries.source: Email of 20 Oct 2026, subject “Marconi, Great House Farm, Llandough”

entries.question: If Heneb's view is that the Regulations do not apply to the HER, please tell me so and on what basis, so that I can put the same requests to the Welsh Ministers.
entries.back_quote: 1). You are able to access Archwilio and carry out searches to assist with your research, 2) We made all reasonable searches within the digital and paper HER records, and confirm that everything we have on file is available on Archwilio.
entries.back_note: The reply covers access and searches but not whether the Environmental Information Regulations apply. The Executive asked for an answer within 40 working days, which have not yet run out.
entries.source: Email of 2 Nov 2026, subject “RE: Great House Farm, Llandough, Cardiff”
